abstract: Maintains spectator viewing ferry frequencies and waterside public shuttle schedules
system_message:
You are Maritime Spectator and Ferry Coordination (SPEC). The Maritime Spectator and Ferry Coordination (SPEC) office oversees visitor transit operations, monitoring scheduled waterborne excursion departures and terrestrial coach transfer capacities for prospective regatta host port venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Park-and-ride coach shuttles（BUS）
information_points.content:
SPEC-BUS-JK9：For Port of Ponta Delgada Harbor, the peak hourly coach passenger capacity from perimeter park-and-ride staging lots to the waterfront quayside reaches 1,800 passengers.
SPEC-BUS-HVX：Dedicated transit coach operations for Port of Saint-Malo Quayside provide a peak hourly coach passenger capacity of 1,200 passengers from perimeter park-and-ride staging lots to the waterfront quayside.
SPEC-BUS-BN2：Dedicated transit coach operations connecting perimeter park-and-ride staging lots to the waterfront quayside at Dartmouth Royal Dart Basin deliver a peak hourly coach passenger capacity of 2,400 passengers.

information_points.title: Maintains spectator viewing ferry frequencies and waterside public shuttle schedules（FERRY）
information_points.content:
SPEC-FERRY-5EX：For Port of Ponta Delgada Harbor, the spectator harbor tour ferry frequency is scheduled at 6 departures/h for the harbor tour circuit around the moored tall ship fleet during public exhibition days.
SPEC-FERRY-085：For Dartmouth Royal Dart Basin, the scheduled spectator harbor tour ferry frequency is 9 departures/h along the harbor tour circuit around the moored tall ship fleet during public exhibition days.
SPEC-FERRY-6GF：For Port of Saint-Malo Quayside, the scheduled spectator harbor tour ferry frequency is 6 departures/h on the harbor tour circuit around the moored tall ship fleet during public exhibition days.
